## Scan progress and Ollama fallback control

- Show scan-stage progress in the desktop job list.
- Add an AI settings option to disable local Ollama fallback. Existing settings keep fallback enabled by default for compatibility.
- If problems are found after release, users can reinstall the previous stable release, v0.1.39: https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/releases/tag/v0.1.39

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.39...v0.1.40
